rules.name: Explicit Acceptance Required
rules.statement: A Delivery Assignment must not transition to an active state until the assigned Delivery Partner explicitly accepts the assignment.
rules.condition: When a delivery slot is allocated to a specific agent
exceptions: Emergency override by platform operations manager for critical time windows
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the start of the delivery task and prevents proof of delivery submission
rules.rationale: Ensures agents are committed to the task before resources are locked and customers are notified

parameters.name: acceptance_timeout_minutes
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for an agent to accept or reject an assignment before auto-reassignment

rules.name: Cancellation Proof Rejection
rules.statement: The system must not validate a Proof of Delivery if the associated Delivery Assignment is in a cancelled state.
rules.condition: When a delivery agent attempts to submit proof of delivery
exceptions: Manual override by customer support for fraud investigation
rules.if_violated: The proof of delivery is rejected and the order remains in 'In Transit' status, triggering a re-assignment alert
rules.rationale: Prevents fraudulent closure of orders where the agent has abandoned the delivery

parameters.name: cancellation_grace_period_minutes
parameters.description: Time window after cancellation where proof submission is still technically allowed for logging

rules.name: Refund Block on Assignment
rules.statement: No new Delivery Assignment may be created for an Order Request while a refund transaction is actively processing.
rules.condition: When a refund is initiated for an order
exceptions: Exceptional cases approved by senior finance officer for inventory correction
rules.if_violated: The system prevents the creation of a new assignment and queues the order for manual review
rules.rationale: Prevents double-fulfillment and financial loss by ensuring no new logistics are triggered during financial disputes

parameters.name: refund_processing_duration_hours
parameters.description: Maximum duration a refund can block new assignments before review

rules.name: Feedback Assignment Binding
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must only be linked to a specific Delivery Assignment to attribute performance metrics to the correct partner.
rules.condition: When a customer submits a delivery rating or complaint
exceptions: System-generated automated feedback for technical failures unrelated to agent performance
rules.if_violated: The feedback is rejected or logged as 'Unattributed', preventing accurate agent performance tracking
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate attribution of quality issues to the specific agent responsible for the delivery leg

parameters.name: feedback_window_hours
parameters.description: Time limit after delivery completion to submit feedback
